title: Build record
description: Implementer output for one round: commits, the automated tests per test case, an answer to every open finding, and the gate run at the final commit.

head_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD after the last commit of this round.

automated_tests.description: One entry per unit or integration test case in the test plan.

location.description: Test file and test name that implements it.

responses.description: Exactly one entry per open finding id given in the prompt.

finding_id.description: The id as given, e.g. r1.1-backend-2.

status.description: fixed: changed in a commit. disputed: the finding is wrong; reason says why. deferred: minor and out of scope; reason names where it goes. A deferred blocking finding stays blocking.

commit.description: Commit that fixes it, when status is fixed.

gate.description: The profile's gate commands plus the tests touched by the branch, run at head_sha. Fix and rerun before answering if any check fails.

sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD when the checks ran. Must equal head_sha.

environment.description: Where the checks ran, e.g. 'local, long-lived test database'.

exit_code.description: A check that could not run reports a non-zero code.

log_path.description: Full output, under the directory given in the prompt.

responses.reason: fixture now sets the ordering value it asserts on
